outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted tactical fantasy battle animation sheet. Reference defines ONE Canopy Rammer: huge biped tree creature with TWO massive wooden fists, TWO thick root legs with broad rooted feet, twisted bark/vine body, moss/leaf shoulder canopy, pale lichen rosettes, amber seams in chest/shoulders. Head is a dense knotted brow with huge upward-forward branching wooden ram horns, green moss hanging from horns. No carried equipment, no human rider. Preserve exactly this anatomy, horn arrangement and original painterly style. Create TWELVE full-body articulated poses FOUR columns THREE rows with wide generous gutters containing complete horns and feet. Constant body scale fixed elevated three-quarter view facing screen-right. Genuine transparent RGBA background no painted checkerboard, scenery/floor/grid/text. Row1: idle settled fists at sides; idle chest expands shoulders lift leaves tremble; walk right root foot forward left behind; opposite walk LEFT root foot forward RIGHT behind, visibly exchange leg lead. Row2: passing rear root foot lifted beneath hips; attack wind-up head/horns drawn back torso coils knees bend fists brace; attack head/horns drive forward screen-right at enemy chest height torso folds hips stay grounded, two fists retained alongside; defense cross massive forearms before chest lower horned head. Row3: hit recoil torso arches back head turns slightly fists spread; dying kneels amber seams fading crown lowered; side collapse hips knees and elbows bend horns settle sideways; dead inert side-lying wooden body with TWO limp arms TWO folded root legs, all horns and moss retained, amber seams completely dark, no magical effects. Actual joint/torso articulation not translated or rotated standing cutouts. No additional limbs, no extra branches replacing hands, no broken/missing horns. Original art only no copyrighted franchise assets.

review_notes: 14 candidate frames: seven retained original paintings from indices0,1,2,7,9,10,11 plus seven new selected paintings among nine built-in outputs. Originals, both unselected new precursors and exact references are preserved.

Source walking labels did not establish near/far ownership. First new opposite-contact also repeated lead; the new near passing is useful but does not fill the far passing gap. Diagram-first B contact and A passing explicitly fix near/far limb paths. Slender guided far-passing precursor is excluded; a subsequent built-in body-mass correction retains the far lift while restoring a broad torso, thick fists and flexed support leg. No local mirroring or warping.

New windup/forward horn-ram/recoil preserve the four-horn head, with occlusion through turns; crossed-arm defense gains a settling frame. Original kneel, side fall and dark inert corpse retain two arms and two root legs. Exact horn/body/foot proportions and continuous motion remain unaccepted.

Source and new masters are opaque RGB, not alpha. Owner-approved connected neutral preparation minimum175, tolerance16 (warm windup/guard24), edge2 plus explicitly inspected horn/leaf/arm gap seeds. Pale lichen and amber material are not blanket-keyed. Unselected source cells are not claimed background-clean.

Explicit uniform per-source scales and ground anchors assemble a512x256 four-column atlas. Actual-alpha atlas and registered offline art-desk capture visually inspected after guided passing body-mass correction; this is production review, not proof of timing or translated gait.

Whole160 refinement still covers changing moss/lichen/crack patterns, horn occlusion and topology, body/fist/foot proportions, near/far support/travel continuity, subtle idle/guard motion, fine edges and actual attack/death event timing. No automated tests/imports/exports, paid API or gameplay/save/footprint changes.
prior_review_notes: Twelve source poses include horn strike, crossed-arm defense and collapsed body.
Walking contacts repeat lead; torso orientation changes. Idle subtle and passing must bridge opposite contacts.
Horn branching/count and shape vary especially wind-up/recoil; preserve exact reference horns through articulation.
Root/fist size, moss and lichen continuity require refinement. Horn strike requires more neck/hip anticipation and contact distinction.
Death transition resembles progressively lowered crouch; confirm two arms/two legs and fully inactive amber seams in corpse.
Transparency/compositing unresolved. Source only, not packed/enabled; 29 candidates and 0/160 final acceptances unchanged. No tests/exports.
